composition: Two independent processes booting the full DSH web profile; real Agent/Session and native Skills; no TUI/model calls
client: Every skills/change immediately queries the native Skills snapshot again
cpuMethod: process.cpuUsage user+system deltas / monotonic wall time, 100% = one core; whole Host process
memoryMethod: process.memoryUsage and V8 getHeapSpaceStatistics; natural GC, no forced collection

durationAdjustment.method: Changed only the test controller deadline using Node Inspector; no child Host restart or modification
